cards.text: Here's a vision, friend, that came to Isaiah son of Amoz, a prophet, during the reigns of four kings: Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah. FOUR kings! Me? ONE shiny new cookie stamper showed up in the kitchen, and I was in the back of a junk drawer.

cards.question: Isaiah's vision is about two places. Which two?

cards.text: Then Isaiah calls out, "Listen, O heavens, and give ear, O earth," because the LORD has spoken. When you call the sky AND the ground to listen, nobody gets to be on mute.

cards.question: The LORD says He raised children and brought them up. What did those children do?

answers.text: They asked Him for a king

cards.text: Then the LORD talks about farm animals. The ox knows its owner, and the donkey knows its master's manger.

cards.question: True or false: The LORD says His people know Him the way the ox knows its owner.

cards.text: Even the DONKEY knows its master's manger, friend. Then Isaiah cries out, "Alas, O sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a brood of evildoers, children who act corruptly!"

cards.question: Isaiah says the people have forsaken the LORD and despised the Holy One of Israel. He says they've turned their ___ on Him.

cards.text: Isaiah asks them, "Why do you want more beatings? Why do you keep rebelling?" I think this one hurts.

cards.question: Isaiah talks to the nation like it's one hurt body. True or false: he says only the head is hurt and the rest of the body is sound.
From the sole of the foot to the top of the head, there are wounds and welts and festering sores. True or false: Isaiah says those sores haven't been cleansed or bandaged.

cards.text: Now Isaiah talks about the land itself. It's desolate, and the cities are burned with fire.

cards.question: Isaiah says ___ are devouring Judah's fields right in front of them.

cards.text: Isaiah pictures the Daughter of Zion like a shelter in a vineyard, like a shack in a cucumber field, like a city besieged.

cards.question: Isaiah compares the Daughter of Zion to a shack out in a field. What's the picture?

cards.text: Then Isaiah says "us," so he's in this too. He brings up Sodom and Gomorrah, the cities the LORD rained sulfur and fire on (Genesis 19:24).

cards.question: Judah hasn't become like Sodom and Gomorrah only because the LORD of Hosts left them a few ___.

cards.text: Then Isaiah calls on the rulers and the people to hear the word of the LORD and listen to the instruction of our God.

cards.question: Isaiah calls his listeners to hear the word of the LORD. What does he call their rulers?

cards.text: Then the LORD speaks: "What good to Me is your multitude of sacrifices?" He says He's full from their burnt offerings of rams and the fat of well-fed cattle.

cards.question: True or false: The LORD says He delights in the blood of bulls and lambs and goats.

cards.text: When they come before Him, the LORD asks who required all this trampling of His courts. TRAMPLING, friend, like a Black Friday crowd hitting the doors at five in the morning.

cards.question: The LORD tells the people to stop bringing Him something. What is it?

cards.text: He says their incense is detestable to Him. He hates their New Moons and appointed feasts, and He's weary of bearing them.

cards.question: True or false: The LORD says what He cannot endure is iniquity in a solemn assembly.

cards.text: When they spread out their hands in prayer, the LORD says He will hide His eyes from them. Even though they multiply their prayers, He will not listen.

cards.question: The LORD won't listen to all those prayers. He says their hands are covered with ___.
Then the LORD says, "Wash and cleanse yourselves." What does He tell them to remove from His sight?

cards.text: The LORD says, "Stop doing evil!" and "Learn to do right; seek justice and correct the oppressor." So turning off the snooze isn't enough, friend: you gotta actually get UP.

cards.question: The LORD tells them to seek justice and correct the oppressor. Who does He tell them to stand up for?

cards.text: "Come now, let us reason together," says the LORD. Then He goes on: though their sins are like scarlet, though they are as red as crimson…

cards.question: True or false: The LORD says sins like scarlet can never be made white.

cards.text: As white as SNOW and like WOOL! And if they are willing and obedient, the LORD says they will eat the best of the land.

cards.question: The willing and obedient will eat the best of the land. True or false: The LORD says those who resist and rebel will eat the best of the land too.

cards.text: If they resist and rebel, the LORD says they will be devoured by the sword. "For the mouth of the LORD has spoken."
